title: Bundle Sketchpad for Compose VS Code Kit Editor
description: Compose VS Code should open the kit editor when opening a kit JSON file. The extension already registers a custom editor, but runtime falls back to static HTML because sketchpad-dist/index.html is missing. Update the Compose VS Code build/package flow so the sketchpad webview app is bundled with the extension, broaden kit file detection where appropriate, extend an existing test file instead of creating a new one, validate the build/runtime path, and track all touched files.
summary: Compose VS Code kit files now open in the custom kit editor across the repo naming conventions. The extension resolves sketchpad assets from bundled sketchpad-dist or the sibling workspace sketchpad build, and the existing VS Code test file now covers kit file detection plus dist resolution.
